description: The single frozen cross-service golden fixture for Phase 1200 DE-01 (D-09). One rule, all four Metagraph atom types (ClassAtom/DataPropertyAtom/BuiltinAtom/ObjectPropertyAtom), two objects with mixed pass/fail outcomes, one zero-binding object expecting no_population, a three-kind Design State, and a geometry reference. All four DE-01 legs (Python data-service, dg-reasoner, the C# evaluator, and the persisted-replay leg via fixtures/golden/seed.cypher) read this exact file as the same bytes. See fixtures/golden/MANIFEST.md for the freeze policy and the pre-declared by-design ObjectPropertyAtom non-result on the C# leg.

rule.RuleDescription: Maximum building height must not exceed 75 meters

atoms._note: Present at the data level only. DG.Core.Parsing.SwrlRuleParser.ResolveAtomType has no ObjectPropertyAtom branch (returns only BuiltinAtom/ClassAtom/DataPropertyAtom) until Phase 1201 ALGN12-05 adds it. See MANIFEST.md 'Expected non-results by design'.

objects._note: Deliberately of class ex:Site, not ex:Building, so the rule's ClassAtom (R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V_A1) never matches -- zero bindings, asserted expected status no_population, not merely defined.

geometry._note: A reference (speckleObjectId + bounding box), not inline mesh data, per ALGN12-03's geometry-reference requirement.

expectedOutcomes.note: OBJ_GOLD_EMPTY is of class ex:Site, which the rule's ClassAtom does not match -- zero bindings, asserted no_population (never failed).
hasHeight 88.5 > 75, so swrlb:greaterThan(?h, 75) is satisfied in the violation-pattern body -- the rule is genuinely violated.

By design, the C# leg (DG.Core.Validation.RuleEvaluator via SwrlRuleParser) has no ObjectPropertyAtom branch until Phase 1201 ALGN12-05; when the fourth atom (R_GOLD_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V_A4, ObjectPropertyAtom) is included in that leg's evaluation it reports unsupported (or error, if the parser throws before 1201 lands). This is a pre-declared, by-design non-result -- see MANIFEST.md -- not a fixture defect or a DE-01 failure.
hasHeight 42.0 <= 75, so swrlb:greaterThan(?h, 75) is not satisfied -- the violation body never fires and the rule passes for this object.
